eligibility: four-digit ordinary equity accepted by historical universe registry
effectiveTo is null or effectiveTo >= scanDate
active on scanDate even if delisted later
valuation row may be missing; missing valuation does not remove membership from coverage denominator
exclusions: ETF/ETN/warrant/preferred/non-ordinary instruments not admitted by ordinary four-digit registry semantics
primaryCohort.survivorshipRule: Current membership is never required. Future delisting dates are not strategy-visible.
primaryCohort.valuationAvailabilityRule: Cohort membership and valuation availability are separate. A member with PE/PB UNKNOWN remains in coverage accounting.

secondaryCohorts.rule: May be built later from a frozen historical system-eligibility contract. It cannot replace the primary broad ordinary-stock inference cohort.
Use PIT-safe industry membership where available; sector definitions cannot use future classifications.

scanClock.rule: Use the last actual TWSE trading session of each calendar month.
scanClock.dateResolver: Official/replayable TWSE trading calendar; never use calendar month-end if it was not a trading session.
scanClock.endReason: 2026-08 is frozen before outcome access so D20 forward windows can mature by the 2026-10-02 completed session without using future dates.

decisionTimestamp.rule: After-market decision timestamp for each resolved scan session, using the project's frozen Decision Clock semantics.
decisionTimestamp.requirement: All valuation, universe, sector and control observations must satisfy availableAt/knownAt <= decisionTimestamp.

valuationState.minimumHistory: Each window uses its already frozen valid-observation minimum; insufficient history => UNKNOWN.
valuationState.missingPe: PE N/A/UNKNOWN stays stateful and never removes the symbol from the universe denominator.

coverageReceipt.invariant: Every primary-cohort member must be accounted for as KNOWN or explicit UNKNOWN. No silent row dropping.
coverageReceipt.zeroCoverage: A scan date with incomplete/unexplainable source coverage is DATA_BLOCKED, not a valid zero-pick date.

antiBias: do not use current listing membership for historical scans
do not require valuation to be KNOWN to remain in coverage denominator
do not choose scan months based on later returns
do not choose the best percentile window after outcomes
do not apply current system filters as the primary inference cohort
do not backfill future sector or financial-statement revisions

unlockRequires: 44 scan sessions resolved from official/replayable TWSE calendar
historical universe snapshot/hash for every scan session
valuation/control snapshot coverage receipt for every scan session
all members accounted KNOWN or explicit UNKNOWN
